resumen: With the upper arm vertical, the elbow bends behind the head and straightens. The long head of the triceps works stretched.
ejecucion: Stand and press the dumbbells overhead with your arms straight.
Bend your elbows, lowering the dumbbells behind your head.
The elbows point forward and do not flare out to the sides.
Straighten the elbows without snapping them locked.
If your shoulders complain, go less deep or switch to a version with the arm lower.
matices: In the cited work, shoulder position changes which head of the triceps works most: with the arm overhead the long head — which crosses the shoulder — takes more load than with the arm at your side. That is why this version and the kickback are not interchangeable.
